description_en: Queries the history of specified or all alert rule settings
description_zh: 查询指定或全部报警规则设置历史
name: ListAlarmHistory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert rule
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 100
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The default value is 24 hours before the current time. You can specify a long-type timestamp or a value in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据开始时间，默认24小时前，可以输入long型时间，也可以输入yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss类型时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The default value is the current time. You can specify a long-type timestamp or a value in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据结束时间，默认当前时间，可以输入long型时间，也可以输入yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss类型时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The cursor that specifies the start position of the query. If this parameter is left empty, the first 100 records are returned in reverse chronological order
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据的起始位置，为空则按时间查询前100条
parameters.name: cursor
